text:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: ap-northeast-1/gpu-pool-3 reported increased packet loss and connection resets. p99 latency 4.2s, available capacity 38%.

maria: seeing the spike, thanks. can infra ops confirm exact pool health? any ongoing maintenance?

ben: not scheduled. I'm on it — pulling control plane and router health logs now.

leo: quick note — if we shift too aggressively we'll cold-start other pools' KV caches and spike tail latency. prefer a staged spill with session-aware draining.

anya: cost heads-up: moving majority traffic to eu-central will add ~1.3x egress + model-hosting cost. ok to exceed short-term budget?

maria: prioritize availability for now, short-term cost overshoot allowed. add a warning/limit though.

ben: plan: staged reweight. target changes: ap-northeast -> 0.2, eu-central -> 0.6, na-west -> 0.2. enable session_affinity=true and drain_ttl=120s to avoid connection churn. executing now.

ben: ```
# gslbctl update-routes --mutations 
--set ap-northeast-1=0.2 
--set eu-central-1=0.6 
--set na-west-2=0.2 
--session-affinity=true --drain-ttl=120 
--meta note="ap-northeast partial spill due to packet loss"
```

deploy-bot: ACCEPTED change-id=chg_1965432100_1. rolling update to global POPs.

monitoring-bot: INFO change-id=chg_1965432100_1 applied to 88% of POPs; propagation in progress.

leo: verifying affinity — existing sessions are draining, new sessions routed per updated weights. no big 5xx spike so far.

ben: metrics: ap-northeast p99 down to ~1.1s, error rate returned to baseline for the last 2 mins. other regions seeing small increase in cold-starts.

anya: please enable a soft cost cap: send warn when eu egress >20% over forecast; do NOT auto-throttle unless >50% breach.

maria: agreed. warn first, auto-throttle threshold 50% over forecast only.

ben: billing-alert created: alert=gslb_eu_egress_warn threshold=20pct_over_forecast action=notify#finance. ticket=INF-4823 created for post-incident cost analysis and runbook update.

leo: follow-up action item: add a pre-warm step in the routing runbook to avoid cold KV/cache hits when shifting >30% traffic.

maria: good call. I'll draft the postmortem and runbook changes. flagging for oncall handoff in 30min.

monitoring-bot: RESOLVED alert ap-northeast-1/gpu-pool-3 degraded after routing change; continued monitoring for 2 hours.

ben: leaving a short note in infra status page with change-id and metrics snapshot.

maria: thanks team. keep eyes open and ping here for regressions. I'll post the postmortem link once ready.
